x: Welcome to the official documentation for Night Mode (Google Play name: Screen Dimmer - Night Mode), a screen dimmer for Android that makes your display darker than your phone’s lowest brightness setting. It is made by Bunkwise Technologies, India. Get it on Google Play

Night Mode draws a dark layer over your entire display so you can dim the screen below your phone’s normal minimum brightness. You choose how dark, and the app shows it as a percentage darker than Android’s lowest brightness. It is built for reading in bed, using a phone next to someone who is asleep, or checking a notification in a dark room without being hit by light. Everything Night Mode can do, and how to set it up.

Install Night Mode from Google Play and open it Turn on Display over other apps when asked - Night Mode needs this to draw its dark layer over your screen Back on the home screen, pick a level or drag the slider to start dimming No account, sign-up or login is needed.

The home screen shows everything at a glance: Status line - for example “Off · Android’s own minimum” when dimming is off Large percentage - how much darker than Android’s lowest brightness the screen is Quick levels - 30%, 45%, 60% and 80%, with a tick on the active one Vertical slider - slide towards Darker or Lighter to fine-tune the level Help icon - top right, for help inside the app

Level When to use it 30% A gentle start. Good for the first night or a dim lamp-lit room 45% Reading in bed with the lights off 60% A dark room where even the lowest brightness feels harsh 80% Very dark rooms, or sharing a bed with someone who is asleep These are suggestions. Every phone panel is different, so move the slider until the screen feels right.

A floating control sits over the app you are using, so you can adjust dimming without leaving it. It has: a vertical slider with the current level at the top a ring button to switch dimming on or off an AUTO button to hand control to automatic mode

Night Mode shows a notification with the current level and four buttons: Button What it does −10 Makes the screen 10 points lighter +10 Makes the screen 10 points darker AUTO Switches to automatic mode OFF Turns dimming off straight away If the notification shows “Tap here: allow Accessibility to dim this panel”, tap it to enable the optional Accessibility service. That lets Night Mode dim the notification panel itself.

Night Mode adds two tiles to your Quick Settings panel: Night mode - one tap to turn dimming on or off, and it shows its current state Night mode slider - a brightness slider you can drag from the panel To add them, swipe down twice from the top of the screen, tap the edit (pencil) icon, then drag the Night Mode tiles into your active tiles. The exact steps vary a little between phone makers.

If the screen ever gets too dark to see, use any of these: Shake the phone - on by default Tap OFF in the Night Mode notification Switch off the Quick Settings tile Press Volume Up and Volume Down together - needs the optional Accessibility service Learn the levels first Start at 30% and work upwards. You will quickly learn how dark each level is on your phone.

Permission Required? What it is used for Display over other apps Required Draws the dark layer over the screen. Dimming cannot work without it Accessibility service Optional Volume-button emergency shortcut, per-app dimming profiles, and dimming the notification panel Night Mode does not need an account. The dimmer itself runs on the overlay permission alone, so you can leave Accessibility off and everything else still works.

t: Dim below minimum brightness › Why is the lowest brightness still too bright?
x: Phone makers set a minimum brightness so the screen stays readable in daylight. In a dark bedroom that floor can still feel harsh, especially when reading in bed or sitting next to someone who is asleep. The system brightness slider cannot go lower, which is where an overlay helps.

t: Dim below minimum brightness › How does an overlay screen dimmer work?
x: An overlay dimmer asks for Android’s “Display over other apps” permission and then draws a semi-transparent dark layer on top of the screen. Everything underneath, including apps, websites, video and the home screen, looks dimmer. Turning it off removes the layer straight away. Night Mode shows the level as a percentage darker than Android’s lowest brightness.

What is Night Mode?¶ A screen dimmer for Android by Bunkwise Technologies (Google Play name: Screen Dimmer - Night Mode). It draws a dark layer over your display so you can dim the screen below your phone’s normal minimum brightness. There is no account and there are no ads. Which Android versions are supported?¶ The minimum supported Android version is shown in the “Requires Android” line on the Google Play listing. If your phone can install the app from Google Play, it is supported. Is there an iPhone version?¶ No. The phone app is Android only. A separate Night mode for Windows exists for PCs and laptops. Does dimming with an overlay damage my screen?¶ No. The dimming is a software layer

Can Night Mode really make my screen darker than the lowest brightness setting?¶ Yes. Android’s brightness slider stops at a minimum that can still feel bright in a dark room. Night Mode’s overlay sits on top of that, so it can go further. The app shows the result as a percentage darker than Android’s lowest brightness. What do the 30%, 45%, 60% and 80% levels mean?¶ They are quick levels for how much darker than Android’s lowest brightness the screen should be. Start with 30% if you are new to the app, then go darker. You can also drag the slider to any value in between. How do I change the dimming level without opening the app?¶ Use the buttons in the Night Mode notification (−10, +10, AUTO, OFF), the Night mode and Night mode slider tiles in Quick Settings, or the floating slider that appears over the app you are using. How do I turn Night Mode off quickly?¶ Tap OFF in the notification, switch off the Quick Settings tile, or shake the phone (on by default). If you enabled the optional Accessibility service, pressing Volume Up and Volume Down together also turns it off.

Why does Night Mode need “Display over other apps”?¶ That permission lets the app draw the dark layer over everything on screen. Without it, dimming cannot work. Is the Accessibility permission required?¶ No, it is optional. The dimmer runs on the overlay permission alone. If you turn Accessibility on, it adds the volume-button emergency shortcut, per-app dimming profiles, and dimming of the notification panel. Does Night Mode need an account?¶ No. There is no sign-up or login. What data does Night Mode collect?¶ None. Night Mode does not collect personal data, and everything runs on your device. Fixes for the most common problems.

Make sure Display over other apps is allowed for Night Mode: Android Settings → Apps → Night Mode → Display over other apps If you denied the permission once, open Night Mode and tap a level again so it asks for it Check that Night Mode is switched on and the level is above 0% On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, also allow Display pop-up window for Night Mode in the app’s permissions

t: Troubleshooting › The screen is too dark to see
x: Shake the phone - this is on by default Open the notification panel and tap OFF Switch off the Night mode Quick Settings tile If you enabled the optional Accessibility service, press Volume Up and Volume Down together Next time, start from 30% and move up in small steps.

t: Troubleshooting › The notification panel isn’t dimmed
x: Dimming the notification panel needs the optional Accessibility service. Tap the “allow Accessibility to dim this panel” prompt in the Night Mode notification and turn the service on. Everything else dims without it.

t: Troubleshooting › “Screen overlay detected” when I grant a permission
x: Android blocks permission screens while another app is drawing over the display. Close apps that float over the screen (chat bubbles, other dimmers or colour filters, screen recorders), then open the permission screen again.

t: Troubleshooting › Dimming turns off after a while or after a restart
x: Keep the Night Mode notification enabled so Android does not stop it Turn off battery optimisation for Night Mode: Android Settings → Apps → Night Mode → Battery → Unrestricted (the wording differs by phone) Aggressive battery management, common on Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Realme and OnePlus phones, can stop background apps. Some of these phones also have an “autostart” permission to enable After a restart, open Night Mode once and turn dimming on again

t: Troubleshooting › The volume-button shortcut doesn’t work
x: The Volume Up + Volume Down shortcut needs the optional Accessibility service. Open Android Settings → Accessibility, find Night Mode, and turn it on. Shaking the phone and the notification OFF button work without it.

t: Windows app › What is Night mode for Windows?
x: A free, open-source tray app. It first turns the real backlight down to the hardware minimum, then keeps dimming on screen down to 4% of normal brightness. Windows’ own brightness slider cannot go that low. It needs no account and shows no ads.

Scale What happens 0–40 The laptop’s real backlight goes down from your current level to the hardware minimum. This also saves battery 40–100 The sub-zero range: a full-screen colour filter dims the screen further, down to 4% of normal brightness. It is never fully black No backlight control: on a desktop or external monitor, the colour filter covers the whole scale instead Overlay method: if the colour filter is not available, or you choose Overlay in Settings, a click-through overlay is used instead Crashes: if the app crashes, Windows removes the filter, and the next launch restores your backlight

Presets: Evening 30, Reading 50, Dark room 70, Pitch black 90, plus your own Colour: Natural, Warm (amber) or Grey Schedule, with a gradual ease-in App rules: dimming pauses while a chosen app is in front Full brightness for 30 seconds, 1 minute or 5 minutes, after which dimming comes back on its own Remember after restart and Start with Windows (both off by default)

Download NightMode-1.1.1-win-x64.zip (0.4 MB) from the official GitHub release Unzip it: right-click the zip, choose Extract All…, then Extract. You can move the folder anywhere Run NightMode.exe. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway. This happens because the app is new and not code-signed yet, and Windows asks only once Find it in the tray: Night mode lives next to the clock. If you do not see the moon icon, click the ^ arrow, then click the icon to open the panel Optional: open Settings → Dimming → Start with Windows so it is ready every time you sign in To uninstall, quit the app from its tray menu and delete the folder. Settings are stored in %AP

Night mode for Windows works fully offline. It has no account, no ads and no analytics, and it makes no network connections. Settings stay on your PC in a small JSON file.

Is Night mode for Windows free and open source?¶ Yes. It is free under the MIT licence, and the full C# source is at github.com/madhavraj840/bunkwise-night. Why does Windows say “Windows protected your PC”?¶ Microsoft Defender SmartScreen shows this for new apps that are not code-signed yet. Click More info, then Run anyway. The source is public and the SHA-256 checksum above lets you confirm the file. Is it better than the Windows Night light setting?¶ They do different jobs. Night light only warms colours.
